scope: Playable Myhra one-hole visual benchmark and full-course navigation
features: Textured golfer with authored IK swing and square club face behind the ball
Textured cart with transparent windscreen, circular drive stick and boost
Photo-informed open tee corridor, fairways, sand, green, pond and cart path
Daylight slider and automatic day progression
Compact caddie recommendation with optional explanation
Aim independent of camera orbit and explicit reset
Mouse, keyboard, touch timing and analog standard gamepad
Course overview and per-hole navigation without losing progress
limits: Only Myhra has the new visual treatment; other 17 holes remain the prior preview.
Physical iPhone and PS5 controller still need hands-on validation.
Swing uses authored inverse kinematics, not motion capture; external golf motion download requires the optional Adobe sign-in.
Course detail is a reference-informed approximation, not a surveyed reconstruction.
Existing simulator bridge remains in the full-course preview; live physical simulator integration has not been validated in Myhra.
